core_business_model.proposition: On-demand doorstep home appliance repair & maintenance with verified local technicians

pricing_logic.payment_collection: Post-service (Pay via Cash or UPI after work is completed)

core_business_model.lead_response_sla: Coordinator calls customer within 10 minutes of booking submission

routes_and_page_specifications.purpose: High-converting homepage with appliance categories, search, and trust badges

data_requirements.categories: prisma.category.findMany({ where: { isActive: true }, orderBy: { displayOrder: 'asc' } })

key_elements: Hero section with search bar directing to /services?q={query}
Grid of 6 appliance categories linking to /services/[category_slug]
3-step process (Book -> Technician Arrives -> Pay After Service)
Local SEO tags for Gorakhpur localities
Trust badges: 30-day warranty, verified mechanics, ₹99 inspection fee

routes_and_page_specifications.purpose: Justdial-style clean vertical listing of all repair services with instant client-side search

data_requirements.categories_with_services: prisma.category.findMany({ where: { isActive: true }, include: { services: true }, orderBy: { displayOrder: 'asc' } })

key_elements: Search input with instant real-time filtering (by appliance name or sub-service)
Listing cards showing thumbnail, rating (★ 4.8), Gorakhpur coverage, and bullet points
₹99 inspection fee callout on every card
Direct action buttons: 'Continue' (links to detail page) and 'Call Now' (tel:+919876543210)

routes_and_page_specifications.purpose: Dynamic service profile page with photo gallery, sub-service dropdown selector, and sticky CTA bar

data_requirements.category: prisma.category.findUnique({ where: { slug: params.category }, include: { services: { where: { isActive: true }, orderBy: { displayOrder: 'asc' } } } })
data_requirements.gorakhpur_areas: prisma.gorakhpurArea.findMany({ where: { isServiceable: true }, orderBy: { displayOrder: 'asc' } })

business_rules: Sub-services must NOT be rendered as cluttered multi-cards; they must feed into the lead form dropdown.
Form submission must send payload to /api/bookings and redirect to /thank-you?booking_id={bookingId}.
On mobile viewports (< 768px), sticky bottom bar must show WhatsApp, Call Now, and Book Service buttons.

routes_and_page_specifications.purpose: Order confirmation, real-time progress tracker, and direct contact buttons
key_elements: Green success checkmark and confirmation message
3-stage progress stepper: Request Confirmed (done) -> Technician Assigned (active) -> Doorstep Repair & Pay (pending)
Summary card: Booking ID, Selected Sub-Service, Customer Name, Gorakhpur Area, ₹99 Fee status
Immediate action buttons: 'Chat on WhatsApp' and 'Call Service Manager'

server_logic: 1. Validate all required fields using Zod or manual checks.
3. Verify bookingId uniqueness in PostgreSQL; retry if collision occurs.
4. Save record to `Booking` table via Prisma with inspectionFee=99 and status='Request Confirmed'.
5. Asynchronously trigger Brevo API to send alert email and SMS to admin.
6. Return JSON response: `{ success: true, bookingId: 'GKP-XXXX', redirectUrl: '/thank-you?booking_id=GKP-XXXX' }` with HTTP 201 status.

error_responses.400: { success: false, error: 'Invalid input or missing required fields' }
error_responses.500: { success: false, error: 'Internal server error while saving booking' }
